title: How To Build A Real Estate Marketing Agency With Claude AI & Higgsfield MCP
description:
Claude just became a full-stack real estate agency. By using the Higgsfield MCP, Claude can natively generate video and images right inside the chat. We are taking dead listings from Zillow and Airbnb and transforming them into luxury 3D tours and cinematic real estate videos. 
In this video, I break down the exact raw intel: Analyze the listings, build the assets the owners never had (clean sites, photos that sell), pitch the owner, get paid, and scale.

#AIAutomation #RealEstateMarketing #ClaudeAI #HiggsfieldMCP #SMMA #AIAgency #SideHustle #PropTech
